sentences.text:
Coram : Hon'Ble Mr. Justice Rajbir Sehrawat
me fe 2c oe
Present : Ms. Malvi Aggarwal, Advocate for the petitioner.

me fe 2c oe
Rajbir Sehrawat, J. (Oral)
1.

The present petition has been filed under Article 226/227 of the Constitution of India seeking writ in the nature of certiorari for quashing the award dated 25.04.1997 passed by the Tribunal to the extent that the tribunal failed to award adequate compensation for the land acquired and for not awarding the statutory benefits under Section 23 (I-A) of the Land Acquisition Act, along with certain other prayers.
2. The proxy counsel appearing on behalf of the counsel for the petitioner submits that they have no more instructions to argue this case.
There is no representation on behalf of the respondents either.
3. In view of the above, this court does not find any ground to continue with the present petition any more.
Hence the present petition is dismissed.
